purpose: Rank only currently EDGE_ACTIVE stocks using research-conditioned evidence and live Stage 6 regime quality. This is prioritization only; it is not a trade signal or authorization.

inputs.live_regimes: Stage 6 PSY29 Live Regime Engine V2 output
inputs.edge_activation: Stage 7 PSY29 Research-Conditioned Edge Activation output

score.method: Weighted research-strength score multiplied by live-regime quality
score.normalization: Each research feature is divided by its locked 29-stock reference, capped at 1.50x reference, then divided by 1.50 to keep each component in [0,1].

provenance_rules: Historical research values remain priors/behavioural evidence, not current-session probabilities.
Live directional state comes only from Stage 6.
No inactive, stale, or invalid stock may receive a ranking position.
No stock may be added to or removed from the canonical 29 by Stage 8.
Stage 2–7 research and engine logic is immutable under Stage 8.
